'''Theoni Pappas''' (born 1944){{r|born}} is an American mathematics teacher known for her books and calendars concerning [[popular mathematics]].

Pappas is a graduate of the [[University of California, Berkeley]], and earned a master's degree at [[Stanford University]]. She became a high school mathematics teacher in 1967.{{r|nctm}}

She is the author of books including:
*''Mathematics Appreciation'' (1986){{r|appreciation}}
*''The Joy of Mathematics'' (1986){{r|joy}}
*''Greek Cooking for Everyone'' (with Elvira Monroe, 1989)
*''Math Talk: Mathematical Ideas in Poems for Two Voices'' (1991){{r|talk}}
*''More Joy of Mathematics: Exploring Mathematics All around You'' (1991){{r|more}}
*''Fractals, Googols, and Other Mathematical Tales'' (1993)
*''The Magic of Mathematics: Discovering the Spell of Mathematics'' (1994){{r|magic}}
*''The Music of Reason: Experience the Beauty of Mathematics through Quotations'' (1995){{r|music}}
*''Math for Kids & Other People Too!'' (1997){{r|4kids}}
*''The Adventures of Penrose: The Mathematical Cat'' (1997){{r|penrose}}
*''Mathematical Scandals'' (1997){{r|scandals}}
*''Math-a-Day: A Book of Days for Your Mathematical Year'' (1999){{r|day}}
*''Mathematical Footprints: Discovering Mathematical Impressions All around Us'' (1999){{r|footprints}}
*''Math Stuff'' (2002){{r|stuff}}
*''Further Adventures of Penrose the Mathematical Cat'' (2004){{r|further}}
*''Mathematical Snippets: Exploring Mathematical Ideas in Small Bites'' (2008){{r|snippets}}
*''Numbers and Other Math Ideas Come Alive'' (2012){{r|alive}}
*''Do the Math! Math Challenges to Exercise Your Mind'' (2015){{r|do}}
*''More Math Adventures with Penrose the Mathematical Cat'' (2017)
*''Mathematical Journeys: Math Ideas and the Secrets They Hold'' (2021)

Additionally, she has written a series of annual mathematics calendars in various editions.{{r|calendar}}
